name: Conventional Commits
description: A Claude Code skill that writes commit messages in the Conventional Commits format from what is staged, plus a palette command that asks for one.

commands.title: Commit message: write one from the staged changes

action.text: /conventional-commits Look at what is staged (git diff --staged) and propose one Conventional Commits message: type(scope): subject, a blank line, then a short body if it helps. Only the message, in a code block.
